target_customer: Itself as a trading operation; the stated end goal is managing assets rather than selling software
problem: Markets are predicted with hand built signals; the company wants a learned system that adapts and acts in real time, starting with options.
business_model: Proprietary AI trading and eventual asset management (trading returns), no customers

founders.name: Kirthi Banothu
founders.background_notes: YC page: former high frequency trader at Optiver and DRW, later led onboard sensor and ML libraries at Argo AI.

founders.name: Xiaoyu Li
founders.background_notes: YC page: quant trader in index and equity options market making.

technical_complexity.rationale: Learning to trade options profitably against established quant firms with a three person team is research grade, though the founders have low latency trading experience.

defensibility.rationale: Any edge decays as it is copied or arbitraged; no data or distribution moat is shown in sources.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Large quant firms already run machine learning trading; no source shows any reaction to attimet.

market_need_then: Not a customer market. The need is returns from trading, and the founders cite years at market making firms; no external demand evidence found.
